overview.short: Eco Park (Prakriti Tirtha) in New Town, Kolkata, is India's largest urban ecological park spanning 480 acres with a 104-acre lake, Seven Wonders replicas, and themed gardens.
overview.description: Eco Park (Prakriti Tirtha) is an expansive 480-acre urban park situated in New Town, Rajarhat, Kolkata. Surrounding a majestic 104-acre waterbody with Sabuj Sathi island at its core, the park features iconic replicas of the Seven Wonders of the World (including the Eiffel Tower, Taj Mahal, and Great Pyramid of Giza), lakeside boating and water sports, themed botanical pavilions like the Rose Garden and Bamboo Forest, and sprawling cycling promenades.
overview.about: Eco Park is an urban wonderland in Kolkata's New Town, integrating environmental recreation, ecological preservation, and international wonder replicas across 480 scenic acres.

topPlaces.name: Seven Wonders of the World Replica Zone
topPlaces.distance: Within Eco Park, Gate 4, New Town

topPlaces.description: Monumental zone featuring faithful architectural replicas of the Seven Wonders of the World: the Great Pyramid of Giza, Eiffel Tower, Roman Colosseum, Christ the Redeemer, Taj Mahal, Petra, and Easter Island Moai statues.

topPlaces.name: Sabuj Sathi Lake & Eco Island
topPlaces.description: Expansive 104-acre freshwater lake offering pedal boats, swan boats, shikaras, and kayaking, with an elevated wooden walkway connecting the shoreline to the glass-house restaurant on central Sabuj Sathi Island.
topPlaces.travelTime: Central hub of Eco Park, 5 mins walk from any main entrance

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Eco Park?
faq.a: The best time to visit Eco Park is Oct – Mar. Summers are 26–40°C and winters are 12–28°C.

faq.q: How do I reach Eco Park?
faq.a: The nearest airport is Eco Park / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Howrah Junction (Kolkata) (13 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.

faq.q: How many days are enough for Eco Park?
faq.a: 3 days are usually enough to cover the top attractions of Eco Park at a relaxed pace.

faq.q: How much does a hotel cost in Eco Park?
faq.a: Stays in Eco Park start from ₹900 per night, with options across 4 price categories.

faq.q: What are the top places to visit in Eco Park?
faq.a: The top attractions are Jatragachhi, Vivek Tirtha, Ghuni, New Town, Kolkata, Eco Park metro station (Kolkata).
